name: free-news-api
description: Free, unlimited API for the world's top trending news. Clusters stories across 50+ outlets and Google News, ranks what's trending. Free hosted JSON on GitHub Pages, self-hostable, NewsAPI.org-compatible, MCP server.

paragraphs: A free news API for the world's top trending stories. No API key, no quotas.
FreeNews follows 50+ major newsrooms and 20+ Google News editions. It groups articles about the same event and ranks stories by how many independent outlets are covering them right now.
You can use the free hosted JSON with no server, or self-host the live API. It also works as a drop-in replacement for NewsAPI.org and includes an MCP server for AI agents.
features: Real trending detection. Headlines from every feed are grouped by weighted word overlap. Each story is scored by the number of distinct outlets, their editorial weight, freshness, and whether people are searching for it…
50+ publisher feeds, including BBC, The New York Times, The Guardian, NPR, DW, Al Jazeera, France 24, CNBC, TechCrunch, The Verge, Ars Technica, ESPN, NASA and The Times of India.
23 Google News country editions × 8 topics. Turn on the countries you want.
8 categories: top, world, business, technology, science, health, sports, entertainment.
Trends: Google Trends "trending now" by country, plus Wikipedia's most-read articles.
